manual/en/mod/vehicle-hatches.html.summary: Vehicle Hatch Configuration Tutorial 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-hatches --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Hatch.prefab", "sourceMesh": "${fixture}/Tutorial_HatchSource.obj" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This tutorial uses a separate Tutorial_Hatch.prefab to show hatch markers, moving parts and double-sided meshes. The example contains teaching nodes and a mesh rather than a complete vehicle. Field spellings match the source. 1. Add and register the component Add VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent to the hatch object and expand hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment to edit its nested configuration. On the same object, configure VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent for runtime discovery: set attachmentSlotType to Specific and assign the hatch component to specificAttachmentMonoComponent. The project's CustomEditor adds this companion automatically; the recipe creates and saves it explicitly. Check that the companion references the current hatch component. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": {} } }, "children": [ "HatchCenter", "LeftHand", "RightHand", "HatchPivot", "HatchPivot/HatchMesh" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "attachmentSlotType": 1 }, "references": [ { "property": "specificAttachmentMonoComponent", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Hatch centre, hand markers and hinge hatchRadius=0.5; hatchTransform is the hatch opening centre. leftHandSlotTransform and rightHandSlotTransform are hand placement markers, not the moving hinge or pivot. The moving pivot is each activeParts entry's activePartTransform: assign the independent moving pivot to activePartTransform with identity initial local rotation. Expected check: the hatch centre sits at the opening, hand markers are not used as hinges, and the pivot starts at identity rotation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "hatchRadius": 0.5 } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.hatchTransform", "child": "HatchCenter" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.leftHandSlotTransform", "child": "LeftHand" }, { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.rightHandSlotTransform", "child": "RightHand" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Configure movement isSemiOpen=false shows activeParts. Each entry uses axis=(1,0,0), activeAngle=90, closeAngle=0, moveSpeed=120. At runtime localRotation=Quaternion.AngleAxis(angle,axis) overwrites the local rotation; it does not add a delta. isSemiOpen hides the movement fields and contributes to the runtime open-or-semi-open state. Check the entries in activeParts for movement. For a two-leaf hatch, use separate Hatch_L and Hatch_R pivots. The legacy example used the local Z axis (0,0,1) for both, opening angles of +160° and −160°, a closing angle of 0°, and a speed of 120°/s. Check the opening direction against the local axes of your model. Expected check: the pivot starts at identity rotation, so the result does not depend on the original orientation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "hatchAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "isSemiOpen": false, "activeParts": [ { "axis": { "x": 1, "y": 0, "z": 0 }, "activeAngle": 90, "closeAngle": 0, "moveSpeed": 120 } ] } } }, "references": [ { "property": "hatchAttachmentSlot.attachment.activeParts.Array.data[0].activePartTransform", "child": "HatchPivot" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. Save and check Verify the component, pivots and movement values, including the runtime discovery condition. Save the prefab and read back the moving pivot reference, moveSpeed and companion type. In-game opening, crew hand placement and complete vehicle loading still require runtime verification. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent)/attachmentSlotType" }, "expect": { "contains": "Specific" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/activePartTransform/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "HatchPivot" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/GetComponent(ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleHatchAttachmentMonoComponent)/hatchAttachmentSlot/attachment/activeParts/0/moveSpeed" }, "expect": { "contains": "120" } } ] 5. Bake double-sided meshes when needed If an open hatch needs visible backfaces, assign the relevant MeshFilter entries to doubleSidedMeshFilters. On the same object's VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent, click Bake Double-Side Mesh and choose an output folder under Assets. The tool fills doubleSidedMeshes with its output. Limit baking to the moving areas that need backfaces. The recipe demonstrates the input and output references with a separately copied quad mesh. It calls the same baker with an explicit output folder, bypassing the interactive folder dialog. Repeated baking updates generated meshes while preserving GUIDs. Temporarily enabled source Read/Write settings are restored afterwards. This verifies mesh data and references, not the final rendered appearance. manual/en/mod/vehicle-light-component.ht.summary: VehicleLightAttachment Guide 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. The command also captures screenshots in both languages. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-light-component --capture Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Prepare the teaching sample. The recipe provides ${variables}. { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Light.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } This example configures a circular low-beam light. VehicleLightAttachment is serialized configuration data; VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent is the component attached to a GameObject. Field names keep their original C# identifiers. 1. Create the component and bind the object Create a light object in the vehicle prefab and add VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent. Expand lightAttachmentSlot, then attachment, and assign the light origin to lightTransform. This example uses a separate Tutorial_Light.prefab with a node named LightOrigin. The same object needs VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent for runtime discovery. Set attachmentSlotType to Specific and assign the light component to specificAttachmentMonoComponent. The project's CustomEditor adds this companion when drawing the light Inspector; the recipe creates and saves it explicitly. For a complete vehicle, create separate origin nodes under MainBody for left and right low beams, high beams, brake lights, reverse lights and indicators. Line up one side, then use Create Mirror and check the other side. Use Duplicate to make another independent light. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": {} } }, "children": [ "LightOrigin" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "attachmentSlotType": 1 }, "references": [ { "property": "specificAttachmentMonoComponent", "child": "", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "references": [ { "property": "lightAttachmentSlot.attachment.lightTransform", "child": "LightOrigin" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. Shape and size Set the shape to Circle. Circle and HalfCircle show radiusSize; this example uses 0.3. Rectangles use rectSize instead, and CustomShape uses customShapeRenderers; the existing Light/AuthoringSamples assets are a reference. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "lightSizeType": 0, "radiusSize": 0.3 } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. Appearance and visibility Set lightType to LowBeam, then use Set From Preset to fill its colors. To tune the light by hand, edit baseColor and HDR emissionColor separately. The brightness and radius in the older VT-1A example suit that vehicle. Keep isAlwaysVisible = true and isBlinker = false, and turn off isAutoNaming for this example. Enabling isBlinker reveals frequency and the fraction of each cycle spent on. At blinkerFrequency = 1 and blinkerStep = 0.5, the light stays on for about half a second per cycle. lensEmitters holds up to eight lens-glare sampling nodes. beamOrigin sets a separate beam origin, whose local +Z points along the beam. Both are optional for this basic Circle setup. With CustomShape, use Preview lights on/off to check the renderers. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${asset}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.VehicleLightAttachmentMonoComponent", "values": { "lightAttachmentSlot": { "attachment": { "lightType": 0, "baseColor": { "r": 1, "g": 1, "b": 1, "a": 1 }, "emissionColor": { "r": 3.5, "g": 3.5, "b": 3.5, "a": 1 }, "isAlwaysVisible": true, "isBlinker": false, "isAutoNaming": false } } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. Verify Check the object binding to lightTransform, that the companion runtime components were saved, that the Circle radius and colors were written, and that lensEmitters has at most 8 entries; Inspector screenshots show field locations and values, not runtime behavior, so look at the light in game once as well. manual/en/mod/vehicle-modding-notes.html.title: Vehicle modding notes by 祝昔 | Panzer War Document
manual/en/mod/vehicle-modding-notes.html.summary: Vehicle modding notes by 祝昔 中文 | English Original notes by @情绪薫. These cases retain the author's examples and use current labels where available. Start with tank creation for a complete build. Find a model The author looked for free and paid assets on Sketchfab, GameModels3D, CGTrader, and other libraries. Some include interior meshes. Check the individual asset's terms for modification and redistribution, then check its textures, hierarchy, and scale. Sketchfab · GameModels3D · CGTrader Problems during creation 1. Place model pivots In Blender Object Mode, open the 3D View's Options and select Affect Only → Origins. Use Move to place each pivot. Check the turret ring, the Gun elevation axis, the Dym recoil axis, and the axle centers for the road wheels and return rollers. On a regular wheel you can use Set Origin → Origin to Center of Mass (Volume). The author also used Parents when keeping children in position. Turn those options off afterward and test a rotation. 2. Set up a turretless tank destroyer The author used a Jagdtiger. Choose Shift+A → Empty → Plain Axes and use G to move the empty to the gun mount. Name it Turret and parent Gun below it. Verify the chain Turret → Gun → Dym. 3. Internal modules are missing Check Is Module Ready in VehicleInfo and use module mode in the playground. If the parts still do not appear, check the internal groups and ensure the vehicle references the right damage prefab. Module names · Playground modes 4. The HitBox disappears while editing Check scene visibility in Hierarchy and the damage editor. The original screenshot used the menu on the right to restore visibility. Select one plate and confirm it still belongs to the vehicle's HitBox groups. Damage model setup 5. The tank flips in the garage Check VehicleTextData → Mobility → Mass first. Then inspect the wheel contact and whether the hull collider penetrates the ground. Wheel physics 6. The impact decal is oversized Open that shell's asset. Check Caliber in millimetres and make sure the Bullet VFX suits it. Test the same ammo from near and far. 7. The mod is missing from the vehicle list The original case was missing its sound assignment. Check the runtime log for package target and version or missing asset references. Verify engine and firing audio and set VehicleInfo → Spawn Policy to Player Pick for a regular vehicle. Vehicle troubleshooting Refining the vehicle 1. Animate a radar on its own pivot In Blender parent the radar to an empty at its axis, then parent the empty to the turret. Select the axis in Unity and open Window → Animation → Animation. Create a clip and key the starting and ending rotations. Assign and enable the Animator and its controller. Apply the materials, configure physical collision, and save the collision prefab. In game, check the radar can rotate independently while following the turret. Original animation video 2. Orient individual track links Separate one link in Blender, set its origin to the volume center of mass, and use Snap → Selection to Cursor. Align it and apply Ctrl+A → Rotation. The author's left link was turned 180° relative to the right. Assign them to TrackMesh and LeftTrackMesh, then preview the whole loop to check corners and mirror orientation. Track preview 3. Limit elevation by turret direction Open VehicleTextData → Turret → Override Ranges. Add a range for a direction with obstructions and set the beginning and ending traverse angles, elevation, and depression. The old symmetrical example used 138°–180°, 20° elevation, and 11° depression. Check for clipping on your own vehicle. 4. Add a thumbnail Import your image, use Texture Type → Sprite (2D and UI) and Sprite Mode → Single, then click Apply. Assign the Sprite to the thumbnail in VehicleInfo. Thumbnail guide 5. Set up external and internal reactive armor Select Reactive on the outer HitBox. The old example used a separate interior mesh to represent the reactive plates inside the structure and classified it as internal armor. Configure the outer block's protection and consumption first. Add the internal representation if needed. Reactive armor 6. A plate is transparent in the armor viewer Inspect it with Blender's Face Orientation display. Enter Edit Mode with Tab, select the affected faces, and press Shift+N to recalculate outside. Export over the FBX and refresh Unity. Check that the plate appears in the intended HitBox group. A missing plate or wrong group can also cause a gap. Original normals video 7. Remove texture from an interior mesh Put the internal model in the scene and open Mesh Renderer → Materials. The old example used Reset in the material menu. If the visual hull uses the same material, duplicate it first, then assign the copy or a neutral untextured material to the internal mesh. Save the prefab and check the internal view. 8. Name the vehicle in the UI The old screenshot highlighted VehicleInfo → Localized Name. Fill in the default display name and the localized names. Keep the internal asset name unique. Save and check the vehicle list in both languages. 9. Smooth a faceted barrel Select the barrel in Blender and use Shade Smooth. Check its shading and silhouette from the side and at the muzzle, then export. 10. Legacy roof and coaxial guns The original SubTurret02 was the roof machine gun and used an empty for Dym. The coaxial SubTurret01 used three nested empties under the main gun's Dym so it followed the main gun. Verify the three paths and the muzzle. Legacy multiple turrets · Current multi-turret parameters 11. Pair and spring track nodes Open VehicleTrackData. Put nodes that should sag under gravity in SpringNode. Use PairNodes to connect upper path nodes to nodes near the road wheels. The old screenshot used a link spacing of 0.12 m, spring node 15, and pairs 2→14, 3→13, 4→12, 5→11, and 6→10. Check your own indices and use Preview Track to inspect suspension compression. 12. Reduce heavy pitch on starts and stops Edit CenterOfGravity in VehicleData, lower it by a small amount, and press K to save. Then tune WheelCollider → Forward Friction / Sideways Friction. The old screenshot used stiffness 1.7 forward and 4 sideways. Change one value at a time and test from the same speed. Physical wheels · Original WheelCollider discussion

"OK:" }, "phase": "build" } ] } VRM characters are prepared with the VRM plugins inside Unity. Set up the model and its bone reference points first, export back to the source file, and only then configure the data and pack it. 1. Import the VRM model Drag the .vrm file into Unity's Project window to import it, then drag the imported asset into Hierarchy. The new scene instance has a character root with Vrm10Instance, with the bones and SpringBone chains below it. Check the existing Center assignments, especially for a model from another author. Use the steps below if the Center transform is missing or unsuitable. 2. Fix the SpringBone center references Press Ctrl+G to open Framework → Editor Tools, search for VRM Util and open the VRM utility. Expand the character root in Hierarchy and drag its Root child object into Center. Unity assigns the Root object's own Transform. Drag the character root that owns Vrm10Instance (named DemoVrm in the example) into Vrm 10 Instance. Click Set Center Transform. This writes the Center reference on each SpringBone, so bone physics is computed around the character's real center. Move the character afterwards and check that hair and skirts neither jitter nor fly off. 3. Export VRM 1.0 Select the character root, then choose VRM1 → Export VRM 1.0... from the top menu. In the export window, check that ExportRoot is that character root and that Name and Authors on the Meta tab match the license information. Export to the same path as the source .vrm to overwrite it. If the source is not writable, save a writable copy and rebind that new path in the data. The copy keeps the original model's license. Do not drop or edit the license fields in Meta. A re-export should keep the original author, license and allowed uses, and only change what you intended to change. 4. Configure the VRM character data Create a VrmCharacterData in the Project window with Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > C Config - 配置 > VRM Character - VRM 人物. VRM Model Path: point it at the source file ending in .vrm. GUID: this asset's own identifier. Keep it stable once generated and do not change it for published assets. Height, Radius, Hatch Start Position: current defaults are 1.6, 0.25 and 0.5. The 1.56, 0.15 and 0.84 values in the older screenshots are examples only; measure the model. Desktop Texture Max Size, Mobile Texture Max Size: current defaults are 1024 and 512. None keeps the source PNG/JPG; a specific size compresses to DXT/ASTC and caps the texture at that edge length. Hatch operation and crew boarding positions are covered in vehicle hatch fit. 5. Check before packing The build collector copies the source .vrm into the package as <GUID>-model.vrm and applies the texture cap for the active build target. Changes made to the model, bones or materials inside Unity are not packed unless they were exported back into the .vrm. So after adjusting bone reference points or license information, finish the export above before starting a build. Before packing, confirm the model path is readable, the GUID is stable, and the desktop and mobile caps suit this release. 6. Reference it from CrewData In CrewData, put the VrmCharacterData GUID from step 4 into the VRM Character GUID field. After packing, check the character's height, radius, hatch start position and texture sizes against the configuration. See crew data for the remaining crew fields. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.ZoomProfileData)", "${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/zoomName/defaultName", "value": "Tutorial Zoom" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${asset}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. Set the zoom ratio range minRatio defaults to 1.9 and maxRatio defaults to 3.5. Use positive ratios and keep minRatio less than or equal to maxRatio; this is an author constraint, with no validation here in code. The example sets minRatio = 2 and maxRatio = 8 as the low and high endpoints. At runtime these two values become the available ratio range: BaseVehiclePawn.GetZoomRatio reads minRatio and maxRatio from binocularZoomProfileData for binocular zoom and from zoomProfileData for sight zoom, and falls back to built-in ranges when the asset is null. VehicleCameraZoom then converts the ratio into a horizontal field of view and interpolates within that range. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/minRatio", "value": "2" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/maxRatio", "value": "8" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/minRatio" }, "expect": { "contains": "2" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/maxRatio" }, "expect": { "contains": "8" } } ] 3. Vision override and thermal vision Enable Is Vision Override (isVisionOverride) to reveal Is Thermal Vision (isThermalVision). Both default to false; this example sets both to true. A runtime thermal lock can still disable thermal vision, so the setting does not guarantee an unconditional in-game effect. If you do not want to change the vision mode, keep both flags false; the zoom ratios still apply. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isVisionOverride", "value": "true" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isThermalVision", "value": "true" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/isThermalVision" }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } } ] 4. Assign it to vehicle parameters Choose the reference slot by purpose: binoculars use VehicleTextData.PSParameter.binocularZoomProfileData; the sight uses zoomProfileData on the active gun parameters. With sharedGunData, set tankFireParameter.zoomProfileData on that asset. Without a shared reference, set TFParameter.zoomProfileData on the vehicle. The same profile asset can be assigned to both slots. In the Inspector, open PSParameter → Zoom → Binocular for binoculars, or Misc Settings → Sight Zoom on the main gun for the sight. Set Zoom Ratio in the game to a mode other than Arcade before testing. Arcade forces 3–12× for binoculars and 4–30× for sights. With Arcade off and no sight profile assigned, the sight defaults to 1.9–3.5× below rank 8 and 3–12× at rank 8 or above. Save the parameter assets and read the references back. This recipe verifies editor assets and references; in-game FOV, thermal effects and mod loading remain unverified. manual/en/workshop/glb-model-import-spec.title: GLB model import specifications for the workshop | Panzer War Document
manual/en/workshop/glb-model-import-spec.summary:
GLB model import specifications for the workshop 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run glb-model-import-specs 1. Prepare the visual model and textures Preview the model in Blender. The PBR example uses base color, metallic and roughness, baked ambient occlusion, and a normal map. A simpler material needs base color and can add a normal map. Route the normal map to the Normal input. Preview the result and prepare distant meshes with Blender's reduction tools or an external editor. Blender glTF guide · InstaLOD Studio 2. Organize meshes for the importer Use Shift+A → Empty → Plain Axes in Blender to create four empty objects. The importer classifies meshes by their direct parent's case-sensitive name. Parent Direct child meshes Visual Visual models. Place reduced LOD meshes under the matching source mesh. Collider Hull collision geometry. Use simple convex pieces to cover the needed areas. HitBox External armor. Split plates with different thicknesses or types. Module Low-poly internals for post-penetration damage. Name each module for its type, armor, and HP. Use a naming pattern such as Body_LOD0, then Body_LOD1 through Body_LOD3. Place Body_LOD0 directly under Visual and the reduced meshes below it from nearest to farthest. The importer recognizes uppercase LOD and reads those children in hierarchy order. Parts that can take shell hits need the appropriate external and internal meshes. The hull also needs physical collision. Damage model naming Visual Body_LOD0 Body_LOD1 Collider HullCollision HitBox HullFront_65 Module Engine_40_10 To generate this teaching file from a source checkout with Blender on your PATH, run: blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python Docs/Manual/tutorials/glb-model-import-specs/create_sample.py -- Temp/ManualMcp/WorkshopGLB/Tutorial.glb 3. Export and import into the workshop Select the empty objects and meshes you intend to export. Choose File → Export → glTF 2.0, select binary .glb, enable Selected Objects, and export. On Windows, open Model Import in the Tank Workshop and choose the GLB file. The picker can import the selection directly. You can also confirm the file and choose Import Mesh. On Android, open the .glb in Panzer War: Definitive Edition from the file manager. Open Model Import in the workshop and enter the filename including .glb. The game looks for it in its Installs directory. Inspect the visual, collision, and damage groups. Rotate articulated parts to check their alignment. Fit them to the vehicle, save a test preset, and take it for a drive. Tank Workshop basics Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Generate the GLB above, then invoke the workshop runtime importer after the game environment is ready. Poll the import status until Succeeded before checking the generated components. manual/en/workshop/gun-tutorial.html.title: Vehicle Workshop Gun Simulation | Panzer War Document
manual/en/workshop/gun-tutorial.html.summary:
Vehicle Workshop Gun Simulation 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run gun-tutorial The vehicle workshop simulates guns and shells without rebuilding the vehicle. Select an installed gun, choose a reload FireState, and configure shell subobjects for the simulation. 1. Select an installed gun Open the vehicle in the workshop and select the gun already installed on it. The workshop edits that gun's simulation entry instead of creating a separate weapon. 2. Set a custom reload FireState Choose the reload FireState that matches the intended behaviour: FireState What to configure Simple Custom reload with ReloadTime Advanced (Advance) advanceMaxSmallAmmo sets the magazine capacity, advanceSmallReloadTime sets the interval between shots, and advanceLargeReloadTime sets the full refill time. Drum drumReloadTimes sets the reload durations for the individual backed-up rounds. drumFireDuration sets the firing interval. Scroll to Reload Type on the right and fill the fields for the selected mode. To try a magazine, set the capacity to 3, the short reload to 2.5 seconds, and the full refill to 14 seconds. For large magazines, the Advanced and Drum options let you hide the grouped ammo icons. Drum mode can fire a ready round while replenishing the backup rounds. Check the timing during a test drive. 3. Configure shell subobjects Expand the gun's shell subobjects. Use Import Default Bullets to copy an existing game shell configuration, or press + to add a shell type from scratch. Then edit the basic shell data and the module-mode overrides for that shell. After editing a shell, press Recalculate Bullet Info and read its debug display again. Shells that use the De Marre model show in-game estimates by range and impact angle. Other shell types use their own parameters. Compare the same range and angle before and after editing, then try the result in game. 4. Test in game Run the vehicle in game to check reload timing, shell selection and the shell behaviour you configured. The debug penetration estimates shown by the simulation are estimates derived from the in-game inputs, so compare them against the actual in-game behaviour rather than treating them as a fixed reference. manual/en/workshop/poly-edit-tool.html.title: Poly Edit Tool | Panzer War Document
manual/en/workshop/poly-edit-tool.html.summary:
Poly Edit Tool 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run poly-edit-tool Use the Poly Edit tool to change a vehicle's mesh geometry without leaving Tank Workshop. You edit the mesh attached to an item, then save it back into that item. Get the Editable item ready Open Tank Workshop and go to Item. Search for Editable. Attach the Editable item to your vehicle. Select that item in the workspace. Enter edit mode Click Edit. In the old UI this button was called Edit Polygons. The tool shelf appears. Pick Face, Edge, or Vertex for the part you want to change. Move, rotate, or scale geometry Pick the geometry you want to change, then use the Move, Rotate, or Scale gizmo as needed. Switch between Face, Edge, and Vertex whenever the selection you need is easier to grab that way. Extrude a face Set the shelf to Face and select a face. Set Extrude Distance to the thickness you want. Click Extrude. The face is pushed out along its own normal, and new side faces are created around it. Bevel an edge Set the shelf to Edge and select an edge. Set Bevel Amount to the width you want. Click Bevel. The edge is replaced by a chamfered band of new faces. Finish and verify Click End Edit. You return to object mode and the edited mesh is written into the selected item. Save the vehicle. Reload the vehicle and confirm the shape is what you intended. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Use a parent ruleGuid with an empty slot on a separate test vehicle. The calls select a face, run the real ProBuilder extrusion, and read back the stored mesh. mode:EditMesh(binding.reference.proBuilderMesh)
return mode.CurEditType:Get():ToString()", "docs-workshop", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "ProBuilder" } }, { "tool": "ui_click", "arguments": { "name": "gen_PbFaceButton" }, "expect": { "contains": "Clicked" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.AssetBundleManager/LuaEnv/DoString", "args": [ "local pb=CS.ShanghaiWindy.Core.GameModeManager.Instance:GetGameMode().ProBuilder
local faces=pb.selectedMesh.faces:GetEnumerator()
assert(faces:MoveNext())
local list=assert(pb:GetSelectedFace())
list:Clear()
list:Add(faces.Current)
local count=pb.selectedMesh.faceCount
pb:Extrude(0.25)
assert(pb.selectedMesh.faceCount>count)
return "Extruded selected face"", "docs-workshop", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Extruded selected face" } }, { "tool": "ui_click", "arguments": { "name": "gen_PbObjectButton" }, "expect": { "contains": "Clicked" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.AssetBundleManager/LuaEnv/DoString", "args": [ "local mode=CS.ShanghaiWindy.Core.GameModeManager.Instance:GetGameMode()
local rule=assert(mode:GetPickedRule())
local got,bytes=rule:TryGetCustomBuffer()
assert(mode.CurEditType:Get():ToString()=="Object" and got and #bytes>0)
return "Edited mesh stored in rule"", "docs-workshop", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Edited mesh stored in rule" } } ] Mesh types and their controls The current mesh types are Visual, VisualHitBox, HitBox, InternalModule, and VisualInternalModule. Collider enable is set independently from the mesh type. Material and damage controls depend on the mesh type, so a control you see on one item may not apply to another. Input formats GLB is the supported model format for vehicle meshes; see the GLB import guide for its requirements. OBJ is not covered by that specification.

manual/en/workshop/track-editor-tutorial.summary: Configure procedural tracks in the Tank Workshop 中文 | English Run this command at the repository root to replay the examples through the local Unity MCP. python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run track-editor-tutorial 1. Choose the procedural track hull Start a new vehicle and search the hull catalog for Procedural Track. The example comes from Vehicle Extension Pack (III). It is a hull with a turret slot. Select it and use the wheel and track categories in the inspector. Fit the road wheels first, then check the return rollers, sprocket, idler, and track loop. The road-wheel settings include count, radius, width, spacing, and position. Start by changing the count from 5 to 6. Check in side view that the track clears the hull and covers the contact wheels. For wheeled configurations, check the tires, motor, and steering separately. 2. Check collision If you build a custom body on the procedural hull, you can give it collision using an Editable Poly part. Select that part and enable its collider. A body collider that touches the ground ahead of the road wheels can leave the wheels unsupported. Check how the shape behaves on slopes and obstacles. Polygon editing 3. Adjust the center of gravity and drive In the hull or mobility settings, put the center of gravity between the two wheel rows and inside the hull. If the tank tips when starting or turning, try a small reduction in height. Save and compare steering, braking, and wheel contact on the same flat route and slope before adjusting suspension. For a workshop replay, locate the part with vehicle_rules and inspect its current fields with vehicle_props. Use vehicle_set_props to change only the fields you need and read them back. For Unity SDK tracks and WheelCollider, see Track IK and tank creation. Click to expand MCP actionsClick to collapse MCP actions Replay on a new workshop vehicle. This checks the wheel and center-of-gravity settings. Use the article steps to check driving and the polygon collider. manual/gameplay/ravenfield-map-support.h.summary: Ravenfield 地图兼容性 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run ravenfield-map-support 当前客户端已停用 Ravenfield 的 .rfl 地图注册。制作当前版本的地图请从地图工坊开始。 分发 Ravenfield 地图之前，请确认你有权发布该地图和其中使用的资源。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.RvlResourceManager/IsSupport" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) False" } } ] 查看旧版 Steam 地图及配置格式 以下步骤用于识别旧存档和迁移手头资料。旧版 Steam 普通版曾读取 Ravenfield Maps - Mod Tools 类型的工坊地图。订阅后，Steam 会将地图文件下载到 Steam 库的 steamapps/workshop/content/636480，每个工坊条目有自己的子目录。Ravenfield 地图工坊旧分类 找到后缀为 .rfl 的地图，旧版安装在 steamapps/common/PanzerWar-DE/dlc/PanzerWar/Mods/StandaloneWindows64_RvlMaps。 启动支持它的旧客户端后，同一目录会生成 地图名.rfl.yaml。出生位置有误时，设 isCustomPoints: true 并调整两队出生点。每新增一个点就增加一组 x、y、z。以下字段和大小写取自旧教程。 isCustomPoints: true customTeamASpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 - x: -4 y: 0 z: -4 - x: 4 y: 0 z: 4 customTeamBSpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 customPartolPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 tileSize: 512 voxelSize: 2 旧版共享时将 .rfl 和配套 YAML 放进一个 ZIP，命名为 StandaloneWindows64_任意名称.modpack。个别老地图可能无法加载或导致旧客户端崩溃。

manual/gameplay/runtime-log.html.title: 开启和读取运行日志 | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/runtime-log.html.summary: 开启和读取运行日志 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run runtime-log 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "marker": "${fixture}/log.debug" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 1. 确认实际目录 连接到要排查的应用，读取 Application.persistentDataPath。这是发布版检查 log.debug 的目录。查看磁盘日志时，可用 Application.consoleLogPath 查询当前实例的日志文件路径。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEngine.Application/persistentDataPath" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String)" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEngine.Application/consoleLogPath" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String)" } } ] 2. 开启发布版日志 在持久化数据目录下创建 log.debug。文件可以为空，确保系统没有额外追加 .txt 后缀。重启游戏以重新检查标记。编辑器和调试构建默认开启日志。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 回放只在临时目录创建标记。发布版使用该应用自己的持久化数据目录。 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/WriteAllText", "args": [ "${marker}", "" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/Exists", "args": [ "${marker}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } } ] 3. 读取日志 在连接的实例上调用 logs，读取调试缓冲区中的近期记录。向开发者提供问题发生时间和操作步骤。示例已验证路径查询、临时标记创建和 MCP 日志查询，发布版重启未实测。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "logs", "arguments": { "count": 20 } } ]

的「移动」页签展开「船只参数」。保持「是否完全由船只控制器接管载具」关闭，勾选「是否启用船只控制器」。将「自动切换船只控制器方式」设为「当重心被淹」。 该选项会在车轮离地且重心入水时切换到船只控制，恢复接地时切回地面控制。全程使用船只控制的载具可改用 isShip。只需被动水面交互的载具可保持两项关闭，使用单独的 PassiveWaterInteractParameter。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar_VehicleTextData.asset", "${vehicle}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/isStationary", "value": "false" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/ShipControllerParameter/autoSwitchShipControllerType", "value": "WhenCenterOfGravityDrown" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. 准备螺旋桨路径、引擎和浮力 在载具模型 prefab 中布置螺旋桨节点，把相对模型根节点的路径添加到「螺旋桨路径」。本例使用 MainBody/Propeller。 在 Project 窗口打开 Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Shared Data - 共享数据，创建 Ship Engine - 船舶引擎 和 Ship Buoyancy - 船舶浮力 资产。示例引擎的 maxSpeedInKnots 为 12，示例浮力的 buoyancyObjectLength 为 6。回到「船只参数」，将两个资产分别赋给「引擎数据」和「浮力数据」。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "create", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform", "children": [ "MainBody", "MainBody/Propeller" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.SharedShipEngineData)", "${engine}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.SharedShipBuoyancyData)", "${buoyancy}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/ShipControllerParameter/propellerPointPaths", "value": "[\"MainBody/Propeller\"]" }, "expect": { 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "asset": "${fixture}/Tutorial_AxisCheck.fbx" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(String)" } } ] } 这组操作适用于需要重设物体局部旋转基准的模型。先复制模型，用副本做以下调整。 1. 调整旋转并导出 在 Unity 的 Scene 视图选择要排查的对象，把工具方向切为 Local，枢轴模式切为 Pivot。记录车体的已知长度，观察 Z 轴是否沿车头、Y 轴是否朝上。 在 Blender 中用模型副本，进入物体模式，选中需要修正局部旋转基准的对象。按 R、X、-90，按 Enter。 按 Ctrl+A，选择旋转（Rotation）。应用后检查对象的旋转值已经归零。 再按 R、X、90，按 Enter。选择 File → Export → FBX。设置 Scale 1.00、Apply Scalings → FBX Units Scale、Forward → −Z Forward、Up → Y Up。把导出的 FBX 导入 Unity 的测试目录。 Blender 后台脚本可重做本页示例。下方 Unity MCP 配方导入由它生成的教学 FBX。 blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python Tools/ManualMcp/BlenderAxisFix/build_model.py -- Tutorial_AxisCheck.fbx 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/Editor/DocumentationSamples/blender-axis-fix/Tutorial_AxisCheck.fbx", "${asset}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/ImportAsset", "args": [ "${asset}", "ForceSynchronousImport" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. 检查模型前方和上方 在 Unity 里检查模型的前方沿 +Z，上方沿 +Y，并对照之前记录的车体长度。在副本中分别旋转炮塔和主炮，确认各自围绕正确的枢轴转动。示例的 NoseMarker 在 (0, 0, 1)，RoofMarker 在 (0, 1, 0)。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/NoseMarker/transform/position" }, "expect": { "contains": "(0.00, 0.00, 1.00)" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/RoofMarker/transform/position" }, "expect": { "contains": "(0.00, 1.00, 0.00)" } } ] 有其他轴向问题时，分别核对源模型的局部轴、FBX 导出选项和 Unity 导入设置。载具结构见 基础载具。

manual/mod/capture-mode-config.html.title: 占点模式配置 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/capture-mode-config.html.summary: 占点模式配置 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run capture-mode-config 占点模式配置描述占点战斗使用的区域、占领点、每个区域的出生点以及区域连通关系。它是一份 CaptureZoneModeConfig JSON，存放在配置根目录下，出包时被打包成二进制配置数据。 1. 准备地图场景 先完成 设置 Steam 游戏资源路径，让编辑器能读取游戏侧的 LuaProject 资源。 DIY 地图按 导入 DIY 地图 把 YAML 导入基础场景；官方或其他非 DIY 地图只需在编辑器中打开对应场景。 编辑时保持场景打开。点位放置和 刷新位置 (NavMesh) 按钮会采样当前场景的 NavMesh，所以地图必须已经烘焙好寻路数据。 2. 创建配置 打开 Framework - 框架 → 2. Config - 配置文件。 在创建表单中选择 配置文件（Config Path）。下拉列表来自框架设置中保存的配置路径，这个值同时决定配置会出现在哪个目录树里。 配置类型选择 CaptureZoneModeConfig。 填写 文件名称 并点击 创建（Create Config）。文件名为空只会弹出错误提示，所以要先填好。文件名不需要扩展名。 工具会写入 <配置根目录>/CaptureZone/<名称>.json，并在内部生成一个新的 GUID。不要从其他文件复制 GUID。 创建出的对象包含以下字段，用途各不相同： 字段 用途 captureZoneName 内部标识。请使用独特且唯一的 ID，不要与其他配置重复。 displayName 面向玩家的本地化显示名称。 mapGuid 地图的运行时标识。普通地图用 MapData 的 GUID，DIY 地图用 Defined Name。 backgroundCameraTransformInfo 可选的地图背景视角相机位置与旋转。 编辑器菜单树会把文件显示为 <配置路径目录>/CaptureZone/<文件名>，选中它即可打开该文件的占点编辑器。 3. 设置地图 GUID 与背景相机 在区域编辑器中，地图 Guid 一行显示当前值（为空时显示 —）。点击 使用当前场景 可从当前场景可发现的地图数据中填入 GUID。 普通地图核对写入值与 MapData 的 GUID 一致。DIY 地图填写导入 YAML 中的 Defined Name（definedName）原值，保留空格和标点。游戏按这个名称注册 DIY 地图。 背景相机是可选的。把 Scene 视图调整到想要的构图后点击 设置背景相机，会保存该相机的位置与旋转。模式不需要背景视角时保持为零即可。 4. 添加占领区域 点击编辑面板或场景浮层上的 + 新区域。新区域会添加在当前场景视图指向的位置，pointName 为占位值（Zone_<n>），半径默认为 30。 点击区域标签选中它，然后填写： pointName —— 必须唯一。区域连通关系按这个字符串解析区域，改名后要同步更新连通项。 位置 与 范围 —— 占领点位置和占领圈半径。 初始队伍拥有者 —— 初始归属队伍，中立则选 none。 用选中区域的 +Pt / -Pt 构建边界。zonePoints 是定义区域范围的边界多边形，它与占领点的位置、半径是两套独立数据。边界点应放在可行走地面，并用 刷新位置 (NavMesh) 和 合并附近点 吸附、整理。 按同样方式添加其余区域。小型地图通常 2-3 个区域就够，不必为了填满数组硬加区域。 5. 添加每个区域的出生点 选中区域后点击 显示出生点（旧版本按钮名为 Edit），再点 + 添加出生点标记。 会出现带编号的标记。点击标记选中该出生点，用场景手柄移动或旋转它。数值保存在该区域的 spawnTransformInfos 中，也可以在序列化字段里直接编辑。 请选用清晰可驾驶的位姿：位于地面或其附近、朝向符合设计方向、不要卡进墙体、道具或其他载具。刷新位置 (NavMesh) 会把出生点吸附到寻路网格并清零俯仰与翻滚，但仍需人工确认视角。 完成后点击 隐藏出生点，让场景视图更清爽。 6. 添加区域连通关系 在 zoneChains 中添加条目，A 与 B 填写与区域一致的 pointName 字符串。 只连接地图设计真正允许相连的相邻区域。运行时 CaptureZoneGameMode.Setup.cs 会把 fromZone 作为 toZone 的前置相邻区域，所以每条记录是有方向的。只有地图设计确实允许双向通行时，才补上反方向条目。 检查所有连接：名称必须能解析到已有区域。解析失败的名称在运行时会被直接跳过，编辑器也不会为它绘制连线，所以拼写错误只会让连接静默消失。 7. 保存、打包与测试 保存配置。 在地图模组的构建管线中，把保存的占点 JSON 加到 Config file。选择目标平台并构建模组包。管线会把 JSON 转换为配置数据并随 .modpack 交付。地图场景仍由地图构建流程提供。 本地只导出配置时，可用 打包所有配置（Pack All Configs）。它重建 Build/Config，占点配置输出到 Build/Config/capturezone/<配置 GUID>.bytes。 安装刚构建的模组，在目标地图运行一次占点战斗。核对占领区、出生点与区域推进顺序。 本例给 Tutorial Town 配置 Depot 和 Ridge 两个区域，连通方向为 Depot 到 Ridge。回放生成并核对本地 .bytes 文件。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.AssetBundleManager/LuaEnv/DoString", "args": [ "return assert(loadfile(\"../../Docs/Manual/tutorials/capture-mode-config/example.lua\"))()", "docs-capture", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Capture mode JSON and .bytes export verified" } } ]

"value": "https://doc.game.windyverse.net/" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" }, "phase": "build" }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${package}/guid", "value": "${packageGuid}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" }, "phase": "build" }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${pipeline}/linkedModPackage", "value": "@asset:${package}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" }, "phase": "build" } ] } 当载具需要内置着色器类型无法提供的 Shader 与材质时，使用本教程。CustomShaderData 保存自定义材质与通道名称映射，CoreRPMatComponent 则在运行时按渲染器的材质槽选择它。 自定义着色器本身是一个独立的 Unity 着色器工程。如果还不熟悉 Unity 材质、Shader Graph 或 URP/HDRP 基础，请先阅读相关教程；本页只说明如何把材质接入载具。 1. 准备材质 在目标渲染管线（URP 或 HDRP）中制作并测试你的 Shader Graph / Shader，不要在另一条管线上验证后直接套用。 每条管线各创建一个使用该 Shader 的材质。URP 材质与 HDRP 材质是两个独立资产，且各自需要匹配的管线环境；为 HDRP 打包的材质不能用于 URP。 车辆原始贴图（漫反射、法线、Mask）和基础色不要写死在自定义材质里。游戏会在运行时按你配置的通道名写回这些数据，因此 Shader 必须暴露对应名称。 2. 创建 Custom Shader Data 在 Project 窗口选择 Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > C Config - 配置 > Custom Material - 自定义材质，创建 CustomShaderData 资产。 打开该资产后，其 Inspector（CustomShaderDataEditor）会自动生成 guid，并提供： 复制唯一标识 - Copy Guid：把生成的 guid 复制到剪贴板。稍后在组件中粘贴的就是这个标识。 创建新的唯一标识 - Create new guid：清空 guid 并重新生成。旧 guid 的所有引用都会失效，因此只应在还没有载具或其他模组引用它之前使用。 在 Custom Material（overrideMaterialPath）中从材质下拉列表选择你测试过的材质。运行时会把该材质的属性复制到载具材质上。 Default 与 Custom Vehicle Option 的区别 customShaderType 有两种取值： 默认 - Default（Default）显示 overrideMaterialPath 和 customKeywords。加载器仍可按默认通道名称回填载具贴图与颜色。 自定义载具选项 - Custom Vehicle Option（VehicleOption）：额外显示游戏写回载具自身贴图与颜色时使用的通道名： 字段 含义 默认值 customMainTexName 写入载具漫反射贴图的通道 _BaseMap customNormalTexName 写入载具法线贴图的通道 _BumpMap customMaskTexName 写入载具 Mask 贴图的通道 _MaskMap customBaseColor 写入载具基础色的通道 _BaseColor 只有当你的 Shader 使用不同属性名时才需要修改。名称必须与 Shader 完全一致，包括大小写。 3. 配置 CoreRPMatComponent 给拥有目标 MeshRenderer 的对象添加 CoreRPMatComponent。 勾选 基于组件数据 - Component Based（isComponentBased）。 在 indexCoreRPMatParams 中为每个要覆盖的材质槽添加一项。index 是该 Mesh Renderer 上的材质槽序号，从 0 开始。 每一项的 Shader（coreRPShaderType）选择 Custom，此时会显示 customNatParam。 填写 customNatParam： urpMaterialGuid：目标为 URP 的 CustomShaderData 的 guid。 hdrpMaterialGuid：目标为 HDRP 的 CustomShaderData 的 guid。 两个 GUID 必须不同，且各自指向对应管线构建的材质数据。不要把 URP 的 GUID 填进 hdrpMaterialGuid。 GUID 在载具资源加载时解析。GUID 为空时使用该渲染器的默认着色器。非空 GUID 解析失败或材质 Bundle 缺失时，加载器会记录回退。需要自定义外观的每条管线都应填入有效且匹配的数据。 customNatParam 还支持按槽位写入通道： customTextureChannels：channelName 加 channelTex，直接写入材质。 customColorChannel：channelName 加普通颜色；勾选 isHDR 时可填写 HDR 颜色。 这些适合逐载具的差异（标识、灯具颜色、徽章），无需为每辆车单独制作共享材质。 4. 打包 单个载具：把 CustomShaderData 与该载具的 VehicleInfo 及其他载具资源放在同一个模组包中一起构建。 跨载具或跨模组共享：把 CustomShaderData（及其材质）作为独立模组包构建，并在载具模组中按其包 GUID 显式声明依赖。不要依赖加载顺序，也不要假定资产存在于其他包中就能生效。 发布后的 guid 属于运行时契约。用新 GUID 重建共享着色器模组会静默破坏所有依赖方，因此发布后应把 GUID 视为稳定值。 5. 运行时行为 当渲染器某槽位解析为 Custom 时，着色器资产管理器会： 通过对应管线的 GUID（urpMaterialGuid 或 hdrpMaterialGuid）解析 CustomShaderData。 加载自定义材质，把其 Shader 赋给载具材质，并复制其属性（包括勾选项和下拉框的值）。 写回载具自身数据：漫反射、法线和 Mask 贴图以及基础色分别写入 customMainTexName、customNormalTexName、customMaskTexName、customBaseColor。 按 customKeywords 的 isTextureChannelCondition 条件（即引用的贴图通道已赋值）启用对应关键词，并写入按槽位的贴图与颜色通道。 属性复制发生在写回载具数据之前，因此自定义材质在这四个映射通道上设置的内容会被载具自身贴图与颜色覆盖。需要保留的值请使用其他属性名。 并非所有属性都一定保留：复制是按名称通用进行的，而载具贴图与基础色是显式写回的。请在真实游戏构建中核对你依赖的属性。 6. 可选的通道约定 载具涂装与污渍系统使用一组约定名称。它们是可选的：只有你的 Shader 实现了对应行为时才需要使用。这些是 Shader 侧约定，不是加载器保证填充的属性。 通道名称 类型 约定用途 _Smoothness float 光滑度 _CamoPatternMap Texture2D 涂装样式图 _CamoPatternTiling Vector4 样式图的缩放比 _CamoBlackTint Color 样式图黑色通道对应的颜色 _CamoRedTint Color 样式图红色通道对应的颜色 _CamoGreenTint Color 样式图绿色通道对应的颜色 _CamoBlueTint Color 样式图蓝色通道对应的颜色 _Lerp float（0-1） 涂装颜色占比 _DirtTex Texture2D 污渍贴图 _DirtRange float（0-1） 污渍占比 _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO keyword 是否启用涂装（当前由 VehicleCamoManager 使用） _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO_COLOR_TEX keyword 是否启用贴图涂装 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT keyword 是否启用污渍贴图 说明： _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO 与 _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO_COLOR_TEX 是当前 VehicleCamoManager 驱动的关键词。旧着色器里可能见到的 _EnableCamo / _EnableCamoColorTex 属性名并不是同一套东西。 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT 是污渍关键词名。下面的混合逻辑是旧版示例着色器的做法，用来演示通道可以如何组合，并非加载器强制规则。不处理污渍通道的自定义 Shader 只是没有污渍效果。 旧版示例的污渍行为：启用 _KEYWORDENABLEDIRT 时，载具 AO 贴图会按 _DirtRange 指定的强度与 _DirtTex 混合。若想要该效果，请在 Shader Graph 中自行实现。 7. RGBA 样式图与 tint 技法 示例着色器使用的涂装技法：把 _CamoPatternMap 视为四个独立遮罩，拆分 RGBA 通道，用各通道作为遮罩把对应 tint 颜色（_CamoBlackTint、_CamoRedTint、_CamoGreenTint、_CamoBlueTint）lerp 进基础色，最后按 _Lerp（限制在 0-1）把整体结果与基础色混合。用 _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO / _KEYWORD_ENABLE_CAMO_COLOR_TEX 控制该分支，使没有涂装的载具保持原有外观。 同一思路适用于任意逐载具数据：一张遮罩贴图加若干 tint 颜色即可实现标识、喷绘或磨损样式，无需为每辆车单独提供材质。 8. Shader 编写注意事项 资产 Inspector 建议关键词使用 multi_compile。若使用 shader_feature，请配合 Shader Variants 构建，避免变体被裁剪导致关键词在玩家构建中静默失效。 在 Shader 中声明所有由 customKeywords 切换的关键词，并保持关键词字符串与资产字段完全一致。 避免只在编辑器存在的 shader_feature 变体；要检查玩家构建，而不只是在 Play Mode 中观察。 9. 在目标渲染器中验证 在 URP 工程中打开载具确认自定义外观，然后在 HDRP 工程中用 HDRP 的 GUID 与材质重复检查。两条管线必须分别验证。 临时修改基础色或替换贴图，确认载具自身的漫反射、法线、Mask 与基础色确实写入了目标通道。 切换涂装或污渍选项，确认关键词在构建中真正改变效果，而不仅是在编辑器中。 加载另一辆共用同一着色器模组的载具，确认共享包依赖可以解析。 检查日志中是否存在 GUID 无法解析或材质 Bundle 缺失的错误；这类错误通常意味着 GUID 错误、管线不匹配，或包未包含该资产。 MCP 示例用教学材质和数据资产构建 Windows 模组包。实际渲染效果按上述步骤在目标管线中检查。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", manual/mod/destructible-object-creation..summary: 用预制破碎制作可破坏物体 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run destructible-object-creation --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "intact": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Fence_Intact.prefab", "fractured": "${fixture}/Tutorial_Fence_Fractured.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(String)" } } ] } 本流程用 RayFire 的 Shatter 把整块模型切成碎片，再把碎片整理成带 RayFire Rigid 的预制体。适合围栏、墙体等需要整体碎裂的道具。若只需在完好与破损模型之间切换，参见 可破坏物体：模型替换。 准备模型与 Shatter 组件 把完整模型拖入场景，选中带网格的实例。在 Add Component 搜索 Rayfire Shatter。如果资源是已有预制体，先在场景里处理实例，生成完成后再另存碎片预制体。 设置碎片参数并分割 在组件的 Fragments 区域选择碎片类型，示例使用 Type=Voronoi、Amount=3。Inner Surface Material 可以按需要指定，用于控制断面的外观，示例中的取值仅供参照。 参数合适后点击 Fragment 按钮执行分割。 导出碎片网格 在 Export 区域把 Source 设为 Last Fragments，填写 Suffix 为 _frags，然后点击 Export Last Fragments，导出切割后的网格。 整理层级并保存预制体 分割后选中新增的 *_root 节点。旧围栏示例名为 Prop_Fence_01B_root，其下有多个名为 *_sh_# 的子物体。展开根节点，先核对碎片和网格引用，再把该节点拖入 Project 保存为预制体。保留导出的网格资产，预制体会引用其中的碎片网格。 在该预制体根节点上挂载 Rayfire Rigid。 配置 RayFire Rigid 在 RayFire Rigid 上把 Object Type 设为 Mesh Root，然后点击 Editor Setup，让组件按当前层级登记各个碎片。 示例中其余设置为 Initialization=By Method、Simulation Type=Dynamic、材质 Concrete、碰撞体使用 Mesh，可按道具的实际材质与受力方式调整。 设置 Fracture Layer 在 Hierarchy 选中生成根节点下的碎片子物体，把 Layer 设为 Fracture。保存预制体，重新打开后核对碎片层与导出网格引用。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 在隔离场景用 RayFire 切出三块网格，再导出网格、设置 Mesh Root 和 Fracture 层。 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.AssetBundleManager/LuaEnv/DoString", "args": [ "local run = assert(loadfile(\"../../Docs/Manual/tutorials/destructible-object-creation/example.lua\"))()\nreturn run(\"${fixture}\")", "docs-rayfire", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "RayFire saved 3 mesh fragments with Mesh Root and Fracture layer" } } ] 测试 在单独的测试场景中放入该预制体并触发破坏，确认碎片按预期分离、断面材质正确、碎片层生效。测试场景可以避免地图里其他物体影响判断。保存的网格与预制体应与本流程描述的一致；如果碎片数量或命名不符，先回到导出步骤重新生成。 模型替换路线见 可破坏物体。

manual/mod/diy-map-project-import.html.title: 将 DIY 地图导入 Unity 工程 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/diy-map-project-import.html.summary:
将 DIY 地图导入 Unity 工程 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run diy-map-project-import 1. 准备资源与 YAML 从项目初始化打开公开 SDK 的 UnityProject。需要官方地图的生产资源时，有访问权限的维护者使用 Panzer-War-Mods/Projects/Maps。地图资源入口 DIY 存档按物件的 itemGuid 查找资源。官方 Projects/Maps 已在 manifest 中列出 DIY 本地包。用公开 SDK 时，如已有权使用相应的本地 UPM 包，可在 Window → Package Manager → + → Add package from disk 逐个选择它们的 package.json。确认资源和配置都已出现在 Project 的 Packages 下。 在游戏的保存目录中找到对应的 .yaml，先复制一份供编辑。地图引用的资源须和写出存档时的 GUID 一致。 2. 载入基础场景再导入 打开 Framework → 1. Editor Tools → 05. DIY 工坊 → DIY 地图编辑。点击 加载基础资源（Load Base Asset），确认后进入基础 Playground 的 Play 模式。 等待游戏环境就绪，在 选择 DIY 地图 YAML 指向文件，再点击 Load DIY Map from Yaml。构建结束后检查场景和 DIYMapConfig。 有物件缺失时，在 Console 找报出的 itemGuid。先核对引用的包和资源是否已装配，再继续调整位置。保留 GUID，避免旧存档引用断开。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 用编辑器所用的 YAML 解析器回读地图名称和 itemGuid。完整场景导入需要已加载的基础资产。 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.AssetBundleManager/LuaEnv/DoString", "args": [ "local typed = CS.ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.DIYMapUserDefined
local util = CS.ShanghaiWindy.Core.Utils.YamlUtil
local decode = xlua.get_generic_method(util, "DeserializeYaml")(typed)
local encode = xlua.get_generic_method(util, "SerializeYaml")(typed)
local input = [[
guid: 2f7d6e7d-b518-4f6f-9c2d-1d2c728f82da
definedName: Tutorial Town
rules:
- ruleGuid: 167798a3-6d87-4ec8-a701-ae59775eb7ce
 itemGuid: 08951884-e54b-4c7e-a449-9f2ef826cbc1
 itemJson: '{}'
]]
local map = decode(input)
local restored = decode(encode(map))
assert(restored.definedName == "Tutorial Town" and restored.rules.Count == 1)
assert(restored.rules[0].itemGuid == "08951884-e54b-4c7e-a449-9f2ef826cbc1")
return "DIY YAML round-trip passed"", "manual-validate", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "DIY YAML round-trip passed" } } ] 3. 保存或打包 如果只调整物件位置，填写输出文件名和文件夹，再点 Save Map as Yaml。名称不加扩展名，工具会写入 <名称>.yaml。要作为完整模组场景发布，则按地图向导处理场景、预览和构建。

manual/mod/editor-configs.html.summary:
自定义内构模块预设 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run editor-configs 伤害模型编辑器里的模块预设列表来自两个内置目录和一个本地配置数组。按下面的顺序放好模型并登记根目录，就能在编辑器里直接选到自己的内构模型。 1. 建立模块目录 在 SDK 工程里建立根目录和模块类型子目录，把模型直接放在子目录中： Assets/MyModulePresets/ Engine/ EngineA.fbx Crew/ CrewA.fbx 当前扫描逻辑只读取 <根目录>/<类型> 下的直接 *.fbx 和 *.prefab 文件，不递归子目录。类型目录名必须是 EInternalModuleType 的枚举成员名，区分大小写，例如 Engine、Crew、AmmoShell、Breech、Transmission；不是 Inspector 里显示的中文或 E 引擎 (Engine) 这类标题。 目录名 模块 Transmission 传动 Engine 引擎 HeatSink 散热器 OilTank 油箱 Traversing 方向机 Breech 炮闩 Elevator 高低机 Sighting 观察镜 AmmoShell 弹药架 Crew 成员 InternalArmor 内部装甲 Radiator 雷达 AutoReloader 自动装弹机 OilPipline 滑油系统 SurfaceControlRope 舵面控制钢索 2. 准备模型 模型根节点需要有可用的 MeshFilter 和共享网格。选中预设时，如果模型没有碰撞体，ModulePresetUtil.SetupModule 会在根节点添加 MeshCollider 并引用该共享网格，同时添加运动学刚体。网格为空时碰撞体也无法生成。 也可以把模块做成预制体，以 .prefab 放在同一类型目录下。文件名只用于显示，不影响分类。 3. 把根目录写进本地配置 打开 Framework → 1. Editor Tools，在 01. ♥ Core Tools 中打开 Editor Config。 在 模块预设文件夹 添加 Assets/MyModulePresets，只填写根目录。 点击 Save，保存到当前 Unity 工程的 Assets/EditorStorage.json。 需要离线配置时，先退出 Unity，再备份并编辑这个文件。公开 SDK 中的路径是 UnityProject/Assets/EditorStorage.json。保留其他键，把根目录加到现有的 modulePresetFolders 数组： { "modulePresetFolders": [ "Assets/MyModulePresets" ] } 只写根目录，不要带上 /Engine，结尾也不要加斜杠。 保留文件中的其他键，不要用最小对象覆盖已有配置。 如果还没有这个文件，先在 Editor Config 中保存一次。 不要在 Unity 打开时改这个文件：EditorStorage.Save 会把内存里的整个对象写回，旧值可能覆盖你的编辑。 4. 在伤害模型编辑器中使用 用 伤害模型编辑器 - HitBox Editor（VehicleHitBoxEditorWindow）打开目标载具，并进入该伤害模型预制体的预制体编辑模式；窗口不在预制体模式时只显示提示。 点 刷新预设 - Refresh，让扫描重新读取目录。 在 选择的模块类型 - Pick Module Type 里选目标类型。 找到对应缩略图。点缩略图只会定位资源；点缩略图下方的 选择 - Pick 才会实例化到当前预制体。 调整位置和尺寸，按 Ctrl + S 保存预制体。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 临时添加一个预设根目录，验证能扫描直属 prefab 并初始化 Breech 组件。回放结束会恢复内存设置。 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.AssetBundleManager/LuaEnv/DoString", "args": [ "local u, e = CS.UnityEngine, CS.UnityEditor
local database = e.AssetDatabase
local scratch = "Assets/__DocsPresetScan"
assert(not database.IsValidFolder(scratch), "Scratch folder already exists")
local presets = CS.ShanghaiWindy.Editor.EditorStorage.Info.modulePresetFolders
local moduleType = CS.ShanghaiWindy.Core.EInternalModuleType
local block
local added = false
local ok, result = pcall(function()
 database.CreateFolder("Assets", "__DocsPresetScan")
 database.CreateFolder(scratch, "Breech")
 database.CreateFolder(scratch .. "/Breech", "Nested")
 block = u.GameObject.CreatePrimitive(u.PrimitiveType.Cube)
 u.Object.DestroyImmediate(block:GetComponent(typeof(u.Collider)))
 local path = scratch .. "/Breech/Sample.prefab"
 assert(e.PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(block, path))
 assert(e.PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(block, scratch .. "/Breech/Nested/Hidden.prefab"))
 presets:Add(scratch)
 added = true
 local mapping = CS.System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary(CS.System.String, moduleType)()
 local util = CS.ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ModulePresetUtil
 util.RefreshModuleMapping(mapping)
 assert(mapping:ContainsKey(path), "Direct prefab was not scanned")
 local entries = mapping:GetEnumerator()
 local found
 while entries:MoveNext() do
 if entries.Current.Key == path then found = entries.Current.Value end
 end
 assert(found and found:ToString() == "Breech", "Wrong scanned type: " .. tostring(found))
 assert(not mapping:ContainsKey(scratch .. "/Breech/Nested/Hidden.prefab"), "Nested prefab was scanned")
 local module = util.SetupModule(block, moduleType.Breech)
 assert(module.moduleType:ToString() == "Breech", "Wrong placed module type: " .. tostring(module.moduleType))
end)
if added then presets:RemoveAt(presets.Count - 1) end
if block then u.Object.DestroyImmediate(block) end
if database.IsValidFolder(scratch) then database.DeleteAsset(scratch) end
assert(ok, result)
return "Module prefab preset scan and placement passed"", "manual-preset", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Module prefab preset scan and placement passed" } } ] 5. 排查 现象 检查 列表里没有自定义模型 根目录是否已写入数组；类型目录名是否与枚举名完全一致；模型是否是目录下的直接 .fbx 或 .prefab；改完后是否点了刷新 有缩略图但选中后没有碰撞 模型根节点是否带 MeshFilter 和有效共享网格 换了模型仍显示旧的 先按刷新预设，再重新选择；确认没有把文件放到子目录 分类不对 文件所在的类型目录与 EInternalModuleType 成员不一致 现成的示例目录 当前代码还会扫描两个内置位置：Assets/Res/InternalDamage/Preset/<类型> 和 Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.middlesharedresources/SharedInternalDamage/Preset/<类型>（包名常量 PackageConst.MIDDLE_SHARED_RESOURCES）。可以按其中的文件了解命名和结构；中间共享资源包是依赖包，本地 Packages 目录里不一定有它的源码。 相关源码：ModulePresetUtil.RefreshModuleMapping、ModulePresetUtil.AddModule、ModulePresetUtil.SetupModule、ModulePresetUtil.DrawModulePreset、EditorStorageInfo.modulePresetFolders、VehicleHitBoxEditorWindow.RefreshPresets、EInternalModuleType。

manual/mod/fixed-angle-reload.html.title: 定角装填配置 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/fixed-angle-reload.html.summary: 定角装填配置 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run fixed-angle-reload --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "sharedGun": "${fixture}/Tutorial_FixedAngleReload_SharedGunData.asset", "vehicle": "${fixture}/Tutorial_FixedAngleReload_VehicleTextData.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar-SharedGun.asset", "${sharedGun}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar_VehicleTextData.asset", "${vehicle}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } } ] } 定角装填使用火控增益 TankFireSpecificAngleReloadBuff。开火或切换弹种后，它可按设定延迟约束炮塔角度、调整转速，并在装填完成后解除约束。 1. 准备共享火炮参数 在 Project 窗口选择 Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Shared Data - 共享数据 > Gun - 炮管，创建 SharedGunData。展开 tankFireParameter，找到增益引用列表 buffRefs。 本配方复制一个现有火炮配置作为教学样例，保留必要的初始化数据。共享火炮的修改会影响所有引用它的载具；只调整一辆载具时，先创建独立的共享数据副本，或清除该载具的 sharedGunData 后编辑自己的 TFParameter。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.Selection/activeObject", "value": "@asset:${sharedGun}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter" }, "expect": { "contains": "TankFireParameter" } } ] 2. 添加定角装填增益 在主炮的 Tank Fire Params → Misc Settings → Buffs（buffRefs）点 + 新增一条。打开条目的 Value 类型下拉菜单，选 TankFireSpecificAngleReloadBuff。展开配置并设置下表的教学值： 字段 教学值与含义 hasDelay / delay 勾选启用延迟，填写 0.5 秒 isTraverseLocked 勾选锁定水平旋转 hasSpecificTraverseAngle / specificTraverseAngle 启用特定水平角度，填写 0 度 hasSpecificElevationAngle / specificElevationAngle 启用特定垂直角度，填写 5 度 isOverrideTraverseSpeed / overrideTraverseSpeedCoff 覆盖水平旋转速度，系数填 -0.5，表示降低 50% isOverrideElevationSpeed 本例关闭，保持原垂直旋转速度 各开关决定对应字段是否生效。锁定水平旋转后，炮塔保持指定水平角，或在未指定时保持进入装填状态的水平角。保持水平旋转解锁时，炮塔继续跟随瞄点。俯仰独立使用指定角度或进入状态时的俯仰角。填写后点击该引用项内的 Save，再保存火炮资产。 当前列表是 AbstractTankFireBuffCasterSafeRef[]，旧的 buffs 字段已弃用。MCP 配方会同时写入真实类型和配置 JSON，创建安全引用元素。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 数组 JSON 赋值创建真实 SafeRef，类型名与序列化配置一起写入。本配方验证保存内容；不修改弃用的 buffs。 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter/buffRefs", "value": "[{\"fullName\":\"ShanghaiWindy.Core.TankFireSpecificAngleReloadBuff\",\"className\":\"ShanghaiWindy.Core.TankFireSpecificAngleReloadBuff, Core\",\"json\":\"{\\\"hasDelay\\\":true,\\\"delay\\\":0.5,\\\"isTraverseLocked\\\":true,\\\"hasSpecificTraverseAngle\\\":true,\\\"specificTraverseAngle\\\":0,\\\"hasSpecificElevationAngle\\\":true,\\\"specificElevationAngle\\\":5,\\\"isOverrideTraverseSpeed\\\":true,\\\"overrideTraverseSpeedCoff\\\":-0.5,\\\"isOverrideElevationSpeed\\\":false}\",\"safeRefAssetProvider\":{\"assets\":[]}}]" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter/buffRefs/0/fullName" }, "expect": { "contains": "TankFireSpecificAngleReloadBuff" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter/buffRefs/0/json" }, "expect": { "contains": "\"specificElevationAngle\":5" } } ] 3. 绑定载具 把共享火炮资产赋给目标 VehicleTextData.sharedGunData。非空时，GetTankFireParam() 读取共享资产的 tankFireParameter；为空时才读取该载具的 TFParameter。 保存后读回增益配置，确认载具使用了预期资产。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/sharedGunData", "value": "@asset:${sharedGun}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetTankFireParam()/buffRefs/0/json" }, "expect": { "contains": "\"overrideTraverseSpeedCoff\":-0.5" } } ] 4. 检查 核对类型、延迟、角度、速度系数和共享引用。运行时代码在装填完成后通过周期检查解除约束；本教程没有进入游戏验证定角过程或恢复效果。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 这里验证编辑器配置、共享引用及保存结果。定角、转速和装填完成后的恢复行为仍需游戏内检查。 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/SaveAssets", "args": [] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${sharedGun}/tankFireParameter/buffRefs/0/json" }, "expect": { "contains": "\"delay\":0.5" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/sharedGunData/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_FixedAngleReload_SharedGunData" } } ]

manual/mod/fmod-installation.html.title: 安装 FMOD Studio | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/fmod-installation.html.summary: 安装 FMOD Studio 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run fmod-installation 1. 下载与运行时匹配的版本 登录 FMOD 官方下载页，下载适合系统的 FMOD Studio 安装包。当前 SDK 的 Windows FMOD 运行时使用 2.02.30，优先选同版本的 Studio。使用其他 2.02.x 补丁版时，按 FMOD Bank 兼容规则 核对。 2. 确认版本 运行安装程序后打开 Studio，从 Help → About 查看版本。下方 Unity MCP 配方读取客户端运行时的版本。已有 Studio 并启用其脚本连接时，也可执行 FMOD MCP 的 ping 查询 Studio 版本。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "static:FMOD.VERSION/number" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Int32) 131632" } } ] 接下来按 FMOD 工程设置 准备 Bank。

manual/mod/fmod-profiler.html.title: 用 FMOD Profiler 录制音频事件 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/fmod-profiler.html.summary: 用 FMOD Profiler 录制音频事件 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run fmod-profiler Profiler 可以记录音频事件、音量、CPU 与内存。先准备 FMOD 工程和 Bank，并在 Unity 加载能播放待检查声音的场景。 1. 启用实时连接 在 Unity 打开 FMOD → Edit Settings，选择正在测试的平台。编辑器用 Play in Editor，独立构建用对应平台。启用 Live Update 并查看 Live Update Port。FMOD 的默认端口是 9264，本工程测试时读取到 9000。连接时用当前平台显示的值。若改的是独立程序设置，改完后重新构建。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "static:FMODUnity.Settings/Instance/PlayInEditorPlatform/IsLiveUpdateEnabled" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean)" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "static:FMODUnity.Settings/Instance/PlayInEditorPlatform/LiveUpdatePort" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Int32)" } } ] 在 FMOD Studio 打开构建这些 Bank 的工程。在 Unity 进入 Play Mode，或启动刚构建的测试程序。 在 Studio 选择 File → Connect to Game。同一台电脑输入 localhost:<端口>，例如 localhost:9000。另一台测试设备用该设备的地址与端口。连接成功后右下角显示绿色 Live Update ON。FMOD 连接说明 2. 录制并定位音量问题 在 Studio 打开 Window → Profiler，点圆形 Record 开始录制。在 Unity 复现问题一次，然后点 Stop。 在时间轴找出复现的时段。左侧选事件轨，查看该段的事件实例和音量，再对照同一段的 Mixer CPU 与内存使用。 打开 Window → Mixer，沿事件输出路由查看子总线及主总线的电平。听运行中的游戏声音，与 Studio 本地试听或已有的参考录音对比。 如果事件触发正常但声音不对，分别检查源文件电平、事件和总线增益、Unity 音量设置。保存会话，改一项设置后再录一段对比。Studio 本地试听也可以直接录制。FMOD Profiler 说明 上方的 MCP 操作读取 Unity 平台的连接设置。连接和录制在 FMOD Studio 完成。

manual/mod/fmod-project-setup.html.summary: FMOD 工程设置 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run fmod-project-setup 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 Master.strings.bank。已有各平台 Bank 时，直接做第 2 步。 SDK 内的 PanzerWar-FMod-UGC-Project/PanzerWar-FMod-Project.fspackage 可通过 File → Open 解包到新目录。实测 Studio 2.02.09 解包后报告 Workspace、Mixer 和 Master Bank 等数据未能载入。遇到此提示时，可以改用完整工程或已有 Bank。 已连接 Studio 的用户可以用 FMOD MCP 的 list_banks 检查项目，再执行 build_banks。以下 Unity MCP 配方检查 SDK 压缩包和已有 Desktop Bank。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/Exists", "args": [ "../Fmod/Build/Desktop/Master.strings.bank" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } } ] 2. 让 Unity 找到构建结果 打开 FMOD → Edit Settings → Bank Import。在 Source Type 中选择 FMOD Studio Project，用 Studio Project Path 指向 .fspro。如果只有分平台的 Bank，选择 Multiple Platform Build，用 Build Path 指向包含 Desktop、Mobile 等子目录的输出根目录。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP "static:FMODUnity.Settings/Instance/sourceBankPath" }, "expect": { "contains": "Build" } } ] 3. 刷新并检查事件 执行 FMOD → Refresh Banks，再打开 FMOD → Event Browser 搜索目标事件。需要制作语音时，继续 语音包实战。回放从当前 Editor "expect": { "contains": "parameter:/engine01_cockpit/zoom" } } ] 命令行已用 Studio 自带示例构建 Desktop Bank。Unity 设置界面的保存和刷新仍待实测。

"variables": { "sdkCheckout": "../../../Panzer-War-Mod-SDK" }, "calls": [] } 1. 下载并解压 SDK 打开 装甲纷争模组 SDK 发行页，展开 Assets。 下载名称为 Panzer-War-Mod-SDK-sdk-*.zip 的发行包（公开版 sdk-2026.11.04.1 约 600 MB）。它内含 DLL 和本地依赖，不需要 Git；自动生成的 Source code (zip) 可能只包含 Git LFS 指针。 按下载校验步骤对照发行版的 SHA256SUMS.txt 检查 ZIP。点击全部解压到新建目录，保留下方的目录结构。 <任意解压目录>/ ├─ Packages/ # SDK 依赖包，与 UnityProject 同级 └─ UnityProject/ ├─ Assets/ ├─ Packages/ │ └─ manifest.json └─ ProjectSettings/ └─ ProjectVersion.txt 外层 Packages 提供工程引用的本地依赖，UnityProject 内部的 Packages/manifest.json 声明工程自身依赖。两者都要保留原位。使用 Git 的读者可改走克隆与 LFS 流程。 2. 确认工程根目录和版本 打开 UnityProject，确认包含 Assets/、Packages/manifest.json 和 ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt。 打开 ProjectVersion.txt，记录 m_EditorVersion。已核验的公开发行版 sdk-2026.11.04.1 声明 Unity 2022.3.62f1。 若下载的是更新版，读取该包的 m_EditorVersion，按版本要求安装同一版本。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 针对并排存放的公开 SDK 验证工程版本、同级资源依赖和首个载具模板。SDK 在其他位置时，调整 sdkCheckout 指向它的外层目录。 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.Directory/Exists", "args": [ "${sdkCheckout}/UnityProject/Assets" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/ReadAllText", "args": [ "${sdkCheckout}/UnityProject/ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "m_EditorVersion: 2022.3.62f1" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/ReadAllText", "args": [ "${sdkCheckout}/UnityProject/Packages/manifest.json" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "file:../../Packages/Sdk/com.shanghaiwindy.middlelayer" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/Exists", "args": [ "${sdkCheckout}/UnityProject/Assets/ModManager/BuildPipline-Template-Vehicle.asset" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/Exists", "args": [ "${sdkCheckout}/UnityProject/Assets/ModManager/Template-Blank-Vehicle.asset" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/Exists", "args": [ "${sdkCheckout}/Packages/Sdk/com.shanghaiwindy.middlelayer/package.json" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } } ] 3. 在 Unity Hub 打开工程 在 Unity Hub 的 Projects → Add → Add project from disk 中选择解压目录内的 UnityProject，不要选外层解压目录，也不要选 Assets 或 Packages。选到正确目录时，应能看到本教程第 2 节列出的三个位置。 在项目列表打开刚添加的工程，并用 ProjectVersion.txt 声明的同一版本打开。首次打开会下载包、导入资源并编译脚本，耗时明显长于后续启动；请等到 Hub 和编辑器进度结束。 编译完成后查看 Console，确认没有编译错误；通过时顶部会出现 Framework - 框架 菜单。找不到菜单时，依次检查：是否选的是内层 UnityProject、相邻 Packages 是否完整、解压是否中断、编辑器版本是否与声明一致。 若 Hub 提示缺少版本，先安装该编辑器再重新打开。典型故障：打开外层目录会提示不是 Unity 工程；解压不完整会报缺失包或 DLL；Packages 被移走会导致本地包无法解析。 4. 先用随包模板验收项目 在 File → Build Settings 选择目标平台。Windows 选 PC, Mac & Linux Standalone → Windows → x86_64，Android 选 Android，再点击 Switch Platform。 在 Project 选中 Assets/ModManager/BuildPipline-Template-Vehicle.asset，点击 Build Linked Objects to AssetBundle，等待资源构建结束。 选 Assets/ModManager/Template-Blank-Vehicle.asset，点击 Package Mod Now。Windows 示例输出在 UnityProject/Build/Mod-Package/StandaloneWindows64/Template-Blank-Vehicle/ 下。切平台或改资源后，先重新构建链接资源再打包。 按安装模组导入与游戏平台一致的 .modpack。地图模板在同一目录下，改选 BuildPipline-Template-Blank.asset 与 Template-Blank-Scene.asset。 第 3、4 步能生成模板包并在游戏中加载，说明工程与编辑器环境可用。接着按需设置 Steam 游戏目录，或开始从零制作第一辆坦克。如果使用能创建项目的 GameHub 版本，可参照环境配置打开它生成的工程。

伤害模型命名规则 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run hitbox-naming-conventions --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 InternalModuleModel。生成器只处理带 MeshFilter 的节点。教学配方创建了两个独立源模型。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${external}", "mode": "create", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform", "children": [ "Plate_100", "Plate_100_Inter", "Plate_100_React" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${external}", "mode": "update", "component": "UnityEngine.MeshFilter", "child": "Plate_100", "references": [ { "property": "m_Mesh", "asset": "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/Light/AuthoringSamples/Square.obj", "type": "UnityEngine.Mesh" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": {
